summary: The client's accounting system behind one contract the app and Exigence share: customers and draft invoices, idempotent twice over (a Citadel reference on the document, and the ledger's idempotency key), invoices and aged receivables read back. Xero first, connected by an administrator; its rotating refresh token kept in Secret Manager and refreshed under a lock. Never approves, sends, voids or pays.

firebaseProjectId.label: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.help: The Google Cloud / Firebase project this application uses, e.g. acme-crm-prod. It must already exist with Firebase enabled.

namePrefix.label: Resource name prefix
namePrefix.help: Short, lower case, e.g. acme. Prefixes every resource, so two applications in one project do not collide.

nextSteps: Xero developer portal: create a Web app; its redirect URI is the xero_redirect_uri output (known once the secrets exist)
As an admin: POST /v1/ledger/xero/connect, open the url, choose the organisation; GET /v1/ledger/status reads connected
